project.name: Google Apps Script CMS
project.description: A personal content management system using Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and a web frontend.

requestFlow: Google Apps Script API and router
JSON response to frontend or public site

components.name: Public Website
responsibilities: Request public content from GAS API

components.name: Authorization Service
responsibilities: Enforce access rules on the server
Keep public reads separate from management operations
components.securityNote: Do not treat a key embedded in browser JavaScript as a secret. Deployment identity and access policy must be verified for the chosen GAS deployment.

components.name: Configuration
responsibilities: Resolve spreadsheet IDs and sheet names

components.name: Content Service
responsibilities: Coordinate preview, publish, unpublish, and archive

components.name: Sheets Content Repository
responsibilities: Read and write content metadata in batches
Map sheet rows to objects by header
Use stable IDs rather than row numbers

components.name: Google Docs Service
responsibilities: Read the body of a linked Google Doc
Verify a document exists and is accessible
Return body content for preview and published API

components.name: JSON Response and Error Handler
responsibilities: Return a consistent success and error envelope
Avoid exposing stack traces or private data

components.name: Audit Log
responsibilities: Exclude secrets and full document bodies

components.name: Concurrency Protection
responsibilities: Avoid lost updates during concurrent operations

components.name: Build and Deployment
responsibilities: Optionally use clasp for local development and repeatable deployment

components.name: Automated Tests
responsibilities: Test pure validation and mapping logic

dataStores.purpose: Canonical index and metadata for CMS content

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable unique content identifier, preferably UUID.

columns.name: docId
columns.description: Google Docs document ID for the content body.

sheets.name: Config
sheets.securityNote: Do not store secrets in a sheet accessible to public-site readers. Use Script Properties for secrets.

dataStores.purpose: Editorial authoring for long-form body content
dataStores.accessPolicy: Only owner and authorized editors should access draft documents. Public API returns body content only for published records.

dataStores.purpose: Optional application roles for multiple editors
dataStores.personalProjectNote: For a single-owner personal CMS, Google account and deployment permissions may be sufficient; verify GAS identity behavior before relying on it.

api.transport: Google Apps Script Web App JSON

publicActions.name: getPublishedBySlug
publicActions.returns: One published item or not-found error.

securityRules: Authorize every admin action on the server.
Do not return drafts through public actions.
Validate and normalize all request parameters.
Do not expose stack traces or secrets in responses.

workflows.name: preview
steps: Return a preview without changing publish status

workflows.name: publish
steps: Validate required fields and unique slug
Verify linked document is accessible and non-empty
Set status to published and update timestamps/version

workflows.name: unpublish
steps: Change status so public API no longer returns the content

implementationPlan.name: Inspect and preserve current app
deliverables: Map current routes and spreadsheet columns
Create a development copy of data

implementationPlan.name: Stable content model and public API

acceptanceCriteria: An authorized owner can create and edit a draft.
A content record can link to a Google Doc and render a preview.
Publishing rejects missing required fields, inaccessible documents, and duplicate slugs.
Public API never returns drafts or archived content.
Unpublishing removes an item from public responses without deleting the record or document.
Administrative operations are authorized on the server and recorded when audit logging is enabled.
Concurrent writes are protected against lost updates.
No secret is embedded in frontend code or committed to the repository.
outOfScopeForMvp: Full rich-text editor inside the CMS
Advanced media CDN and search indexing
notes: This JSON describes the target architecture and does not imply all components are implemented.
Current repository code is a basic starter; component status values distinguish existing basics from planned components.
Google Sheets and Apps Script quotas should be evaluated against expected traffic and content volume.
